szoveg_eredeti:
Mistral Large 4 is built for the industries where sovereign AI matters most.

🏭 In manufacturing, it can turn 2D blueprints into usable 3D models in CAD software.

📊 In finance, it can process complex spreadsheets, analyze large volumes of data and extract insights from financial filings.

🛰 In geospatial work, it can analyze satellite and aerial imagery to detect wildfires, track crop health or monitor power line risks.

And because its weights are open, organizations can run it on their own infrastructure, adapt it to their needs and keep full control of their data.

We don't build this alone. Thank you to the organizations testing and exploring Mistral Large 4 with us: ABN AMRO Bank N.V. , ASML , Belfius , Crédit Agricole , European Space Agency - ESA , Hugging Face , La Banque Postale and ZML .
